body:
## Parent

https://github.com/Piyushmanyata/snp-camps/issues/36

## What to build

One explicit, boring way for client components to reconcile optimistic edits against fresh server data — used in all three places that currently invent their own.

Three components detect a fresh server render by comparing the `initial` prop **by reference identity**, then rebuild derived state from it. The live queue does this twice, once more to decide between two toast messages. The admin patient list does it in three separate places with an extra flag alongside.

It works. It depends on an implicit guarantee about array identity across renders that nothing enforces, is impossible to reason about quickly, and is repeated verbatim.

## Decisions already made — do not re-decide these

1. **The pattern: derive from server props every render; hold only the pending-mutation set in state, keyed by patient id.** The rendered list is `serverRows` minus `pendingRemovals`, plus any `pendingAdditions`. There is no "rebuild derived state on a fresh render" step because there is no derived state to rebuild.
2. **No component branches on the reference identity of a prop.** Not with `useRef`, not with `useEffect` dependency tricks, not with a comparison helper. This is the whole point.
3. **A failed refresh restores the pending item to the list and shows an error.** It must not vanish. This is the case the current code handles by accident and would be easy to lose in a rewrite — test it explicitly.
4. **The two-toast branch in the live queue is decided by the mutation's own outcome**, not by whether the server prop changed identity. If the mutation succeeded, show the success toast; if it failed, show the failure toast. The current identity-comparison is standing in for information the mutation already has.
5. **The same approach in all three components.** If one of them genuinely cannot use it, that is a finding — write it up rather than leaving a fourth pattern behind.
6. **Extract the pending-set logic as a pure module** under `src/lib` and test it at the `node:test` seam: apply pending removal, server catches up and the pending entry retires, refresh fails and the entry is restored, two pending removals resolve independently.
7. **No behaviour change.** Optimistic removal and refresh must look the same to a user.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No component compares a prop by reference identity
- [ ] All three components use the same reconciliation approach
- [ ] The pending-set logic is a pure module with behaviour tests
- [ ] Optimistic removal still feels instant
- [ ] A failed refresh restores the item and shows an error — verified by forcing a refresh failure
- [ ] Two concurrent optimistic removals resolve independently
- [ ] The live queue's two toast messages are chosen from the mutation outcome, not from prop identity
- [ ] The extra flag in the admin patient list is gone
- [ ] Zero user-visible behaviour change — state what you verified
- [ ] `npm run verify` and `npm run test:e2e` pass, output pasted

## Verification

```bash
npm run verify
npm run test:e2e
```

Then in a browser: remove a patient from the queue and confirm it disappears immediately; force the refresh to fail (offline the tab mid-action) and confirm the patient comes back with an error rather than silently vanishing.

## Do not do

- Do not keep the identity comparison anywhere, including "just in the one component where it is hard".
- Do not introduce a client state library for this.
- Do not let a failed refresh swallow the item.

## Blocked by

- https://github.com/Piyushmanyata/snp-camps/issues/37
- https://github.com/Piyushmanyata/snp-camps/issues/39

comments.body:
Closed as **superseded** under spec #41.

This ticket unifies the reconciliation-by-identity pattern across its three call sites: the live queue (twice), and the admin patient list (three places).

All three are rewritten by spec #41 — #46 changes what the queue contains (only checked-in patients), #53 changes how it refreshes and what the endpoint returns, and #47 rebuilds the form. Standardising a pattern in code that is about to be replaced would be work done twice.

**The finding itself remains valid and is not being dismissed:** comparing an `initial` prop by reference identity depends on an implicit guarantee about array identity across renders that nothing enforces. The tickets that rewrite these components should not reintroduce it. If the pattern survives the rewrites, this ticket should be reopened with the surviving call sites named.

title: Replace the server-snapshot reconciliation-by-identity pattern
